career_spells.role: Industrial officer / lawyer; title transitions unconfirmed
career_spells.evidence_note: Own statement and first-speech acknowledgement support union industrial/legal work. WAIRC records a right-of-entry permit issued for French as a UPFU card holder on 3 August 2022, establishing association by that date but not the employment commencement. Supreme Court records admission to legal practice on 3 November 2023, so earlier work is not labelled lawyer. End date, title transition, hours and leave remain unknown; union employment is not private-enterprise legal practice.

research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen roster (empty occupations), ALP and MP biographies, first speech, explicit 2026 workplace speech and ABC 2022 guide. Public LinkedIn open returned (999) Unknown Status Code; no bypass attempted.

Identify pub and electrical employers/entities, dates, hours, leave and job changes. Resolve degree/trade sequence discrepancy between ABC 2022 and current first-person summary; obtain university/admission records. Separate employment hours from study and campaign periods.

Obtain ETU and UPFU role titles, appointment/cessation dates and employment conditions from union annual reports/staff archives; check whether any private legal-practice employer exists. Do not treat all legal work as private sector.

Namesake exclusions: MinterEllison Perth partner, US McKinsey executive and Lake Forest Park mayor named Tom French were not matched to this MP and were not used. Broad teaching search produced unrelated people and no evidence of teaching employment.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: public profile supplies previously absent ETU title/branch/month interval; 2014 ALP/ETU joining is membership, not employment. July 2025 interview identifies Newcastle subcontract bar work; no calendar boundaries invented from WorkChoices reference.
Named education providers from published Q&A, supported by first-person TAFE pathway speech; dates still unknown. Prior law-before-electrical versus later-law narrative discrepancy remains open.

Searches of union/industrial tribunal records and pub/electrical employer terms did not reveal individual contracts or business names. LinkedIn direct 999; unrelated GenusPlus and MinterEllison namesakes not attributed. Next: ETU/UPFU staff annual reports, Murdoch graduation/admission, historical regional pub licence and apprenticeship employer.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: WAIRC right-of-entry record establishes UPFU association by 3 August 2022; Supreme Court record fixes legal admission at 3 November 2023. Public professional profile supplies Newcastle 2003–2006, Murdoch 2018–2023, October 2014 Certificate III and electrical project sites. Sites were not converted into employers. ABC and PerthNow corroborate WA ETU presidency in 2018–2019, recorded as union office without assuming pay. Search false positive: Australian Property Services Association records concern a Queensland-based namesake/official and were not attributed. Remaining gaps: all hospitality/pub entities and dates; apprenticeship and electrical payroll employers, site dates/hours/leave; UPFU appointment/cessation and title transition; ETU 2024–2025 hours and campaign leave.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted UPFU/ETU employer-domain, industrial-officer and apprenticeship/payroll searches did not identify an attributable new appointment or full-time record. Public UPFU employer team page https://ufuofwa.net.au/union-leadership-profile/ retrieved 2026-10-04 identifies Thomas Nolan, not French, as the Tom who commenced September 2013; rejected that tempting namesake chronology. ALP biography still supplies only broad electrical-project history. Public GenusPlus Tom French profile has no demonstrated connection to this member and is not attributed. Retain unnamed hospitality/pub and apprenticeship employers, exact electrical/union transitions, leave and hours gaps. Search1 returned unrelated generic industrial/employer results; recovered with Search2 and direct primary team-page inspection.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Targeted current MP biography, Murdoch-domain, regional pub/Merriwa/Newcastle and full legal-name employer searches returned no attributable payroll entity or hours/leave. Age25 apprenticeship reference remains a lead rather than invented2008start;2026government apprenticeship statement corroborates former-electrician experience but scheme-wide wages/durations are not personal evidence. USconstruction Welch/Rushe and NorthernIrelandteacher/publican namesakes rejected. No new employment boundary; retain historical pub licence, apprenticeship employer and union staff archives as specific next avenues.
